response:
You are not being dramatic. It is very common to minimize our own pain by comparing it to what others have experienced, but trauma and distress are not a competition. Your feelings are completely valid, regardless of how your experiences measure up to someone else's. The fact that you are having flashbacks and constant intrusive thoughts shows that whatever you went through had a profound impact on you, and your mind is still trying to process it. 

Feeling stuck in the past is incredibly exhausting, and you don't have to navigate this alone. Because flashbacks can be so overwhelming, it could be very helpful to speak with a mental health professional. They can help you understand why your brain is holding onto these memories and provide tools to help you find relief and move forward. Your pain deserves care and attention, no matter what caused it.
